Launchd GUI/TUI alternatives if Launchdeck is not enough:

- Launchdeck (current): TUI for launchd + Homebrew services. Status, schedules, logs, guarded start/stop. brew: sderosiaux/tap/launchdeck. https://github.com/sderosiaux/launchdeck

- LaunchControl (best full GUI): soma-zone Mac app. All domains, broken-plist diagnostics, log/debug views, start/stop/load/unload. Paid ~$33. brew install --cask launchcontrol. https://www.soma-zone.com/LaunchControl/

- Lingon Pro: simpler commercial GUI. https://www.peterborgapps.com/lingon/

- mac-dash: open-source desktop/web dashboard (Tauri or local Bun server). Aims at Lingon feature parity. macOS 13+. https://talhaorak.github.io/mac-dash/

- launchd-ui: free Tauri GUI. Browse user/system agents, start/stop/restart, logs, plist edit. System jobs are read-only. https://github.com/azu/launchd-ui

- launchr: user-agents-only GUI (gui/ domain). Load/unload/enable/disable/run now, form + raw plist, tail logs. https://github.com/scoult/launchr

Ownership note: mise owns cc-notify and git-maintenance-* via TOML. Inspect with these tools; do not treat GUI plist edits as source of truth — the next `mise -E dev run services:apply` rewrites them.
close_reason: Launchdeck tap and formula declared in Darwin common Homebrew config

title: Diagnose Codex CLI incomplete local package error

New daemon startup requires a packaged layout rooted by codex-package.json plus bin/codex, bin/codex-code-mode-host, and codex-path/rg.
